title: Glucose meter Usage and Impact in Daily lifE – Diabetes Mellitus
summary:
The study is an observational study. Participants do not have to visit the study centre, but will continue to be cared for by their treating physician as part of standard care.

The main aim of this observational study is to investigate the handling of blood glucose meters and their effects on diabetes therapy in a real-life care context.
diabetes therapy in a real care context.  For this purpose, online questionnaires are regularly sent to the participants.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-	Adults aged 18 years or older
-	Individuals using a RTCGM as part of their diabetes management
-	Access to the internet and a compatible smartphone or computer
-	Commitment to answer online questionnaires
-	Ability to provide signed informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
-	Employees any institution involved in conducting, organizing, or financing the study
